claims.claim: Applicants must be aged 16 to State Pension age.
claims.quote: You may still be able to apply if you got Personal Independence Payment (PIP) in the 12 months before you reached State Pension age.
claims.note: The usual age range is 16 to State Pension age, but the suitability checker names a possible exception after State Pension age.

claims.claim: Applicants must provide medical evidence of their condition.
claims.quote: You need to provide a document from a professional that confirms your conditions, disability or needs.
claims.note: A professional document confirming the condition or needs is required, but it need not be medical evidence specifically.

claims.claim: Applicants provide details of how their condition affects daily life.
claims.quote: Part 2 asks you about: your condition and how it affects your ability to look after yourself, understand information, and communicate what help and support you need and why
claims.note: Part 2 explicitly asks how the condition affects everyday functions and support needs.

claims.claim: Applicants must provide GP or consultant details.
claims.note: The supplied text mentions a GP letter as an example of supporting information but does not require GP or consultant contact details.
